design_system.buttons.note: One primary action per decision. These controls demonstrate feedback without saving data.
design_system.buttons.title: Actions
design_system.components.description: Try the controls, open a dialog and move through the page with your keyboard. Each component has a purpose and predictable feedback.
design_system.components.rule_body: Visible focus, explicit labels and comfortable targets are part of the design. Serious errors use calm, practical language and no mascot.
design_system.components.title: Small details. Familiar gestures.
design_system.dialog.description: Name the studio specimen. This interactive reference does not create or save a real animation.

design_system.dialog.title: A new little beginning.
design_system.empty.description: Your library starts with one small creation. Let’s give it a name.

design_system.fields.hint: A clear name makes your creation easier to find.
design_system.fields.label: Animation name
design_system.fields.title: A little guidance
design_system.footer: Rose Atelier — a design proposal for Life Pixel.
design_system.foundations.description: Colour, type, spacing and motion: a small set of deliberate choices that bring the whole experience together.
design_system.foundations.rule_body: The light and dark themes share the same semantic tokens. The artwork stays on a neutral checkerboard, so the interface never changes how you judge a colour.
design_system.foundations.title: A shared language.
design_system.geometry.description: A 4 px spacing rhythm. Soft corners around the interface; crisp pixels inside the canvas.
design_system.geometry.note: 44 px interaction targets. Smaller decoration never means a smaller touch target.
design_system.geometry.title: Space for every idea.
design_system.journey.animate.body: Duplicate a frame, change a detail, adjust its duration and play. Explain onion skin at the moment it becomes useful.
design_system.journey.animate.title: Give the drawing a heartbeat
design_system.journey.draw.body: The pencil is ready, the palette is close, and undo is easy to find. Offer a short, dismissible hint exactly where it helps.
design_system.journey.draw.title: Find the first small gesture
design_system.journey.export.body: Compare real export sizes, choose a format and download. For WASM, continue to an integration snippet and a playback check.
design_system.journey.export.title: Take it into the world
design_system.journey.start.body: Choose dimensions or import a PNG. Guest mode explains that work is temporary before the first pixel is drawn.
design_system.journey.start.title: Start with a blank canvas
design_system.journeys.description: A proposed first-creation journey built around the V1 features. Each step offers one useful next action, without a compulsory account or a long tour.
design_system.journeys.recovery_body: Save failures, conflicts, guest mode and offline work have explicit recovery paths in the documentation.
design_system.journeys.recovery_title: Every journey has a way back.
design_system.journeys.title: From a spark to a little life.
design_system.mascot.alt: Pip, a cream pixel bunny with rosy cheeks, holding a small heart.
design_system.overview.caption: Made for artists, developers and curious minds.
design_system.overview.description: A soft, playful atelier for bringing your ideas to life. A visual language that makes creating feel simple, welcoming and entirely yours.
design_system.overview.eyebrow: A SMALL WORLD, FULL OF LIFE
design_system.overview.title: Little pixels. Big feelings.
design_system.palette.note: Light-theme brand swatches. Raspberry is reserved for actions; pastels give the interface room to breathe.
design_system.palette.title: Softness, with character.
design_system.principle.clear.body: Quiet controls, clear choices and a neutral canvas. Your art takes centre stage.
design_system.principle.clear.title: Room to create
design_system.principle.play.body: Pixel details and a chibi companion, placed just where a little joy helps.
design_system.principle.play.title: A spark of character
design_system.principle.warm.body: Blush pink, cream and rounded shapes. A place where it feels good to begin.
design_system.principle.warm.title: A warm welcome
design_system.sidebar_note: A little care in every pixel.
design_system.status.danger: Save failed. Your work is still here. · Example
design_system.status.note: Status uses words and symbols as well as colour. Important errors stay visible beside the action.
design_system.status.title: Always know where you stand
design_system.status.warning: Guest mode: export before leaving. · Example
design_system.studio.description: An editor layout specimen. Try tool selection, palette selection, frames, zoom and the export panel. Drawing and file exports belong to the real application.

design_system.studio.neutral: Neutral surroundings keep your artwork’s colours honest.
design_system.studio.rule_body: The selected tool has a border and a side mark. The selected palette colour has a check. On small screens, the inspector moves below the canvas.
design_system.studio.timeline_hint: Select a frame to change Pip’s pose.
design_system.studio.title: The art comes first.
